title: The zero locus of an intersection of two ideals is the union of the zero loci
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I,J\subseteq R$ ideals; for an ideal $\mathfrak a\subseteq R$ let $V(\mathfrak a)=\{\mathfrak p\subset R\text{ prime}:\mathfrak a\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$. Then $V(I\cap J)=V(I)\cup V(J)$.
